verdict.rationale: Per-employee workstation compliance tracking is a fair question for a compliance automation platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents generic monitors on connected cloud systems (AWS, Azure, GCP) and native integrations. It never mentions an endpoint agent, an MDM integration, disk encryption, screen lock, password manager checks, or a per-employee device view.

support.subject: As an IT admin, workstation compliance is tracked per employee — disk encryption, screen lock, password manager — via an agent or MDM integration
